summary: Tested the /xoiris-scheduling page fix (removal of undefined CAPABILITIES/COMMS/Check refs, new FeatureIndex accordion). Page loads with zero console/runtime errors. New 'Full feature set' accordion renders correctly with all 4 groups (schedule, communication, intake, security), default-open first group, correct expand/collapse accordion behavior (verified via JS-dispatched click to avoid Playwright mouse-path hovering over the nav mega-menu), Plus icon rotates 45deg (matrix confirms rotation) on open and resets on close, no checkbox/checkmark icons present, no rounded corners anywhere in the new section. Rest of page (Hero, Overview, Filling the schedule, What it delivers, Platform/specs table, In the system, FAQ, Demo CTA) all render fine — no regressions.

issues: Cookie consent banner remains persistently rendered/visible at bottom of viewport even after clicking 'Accept All' — pre-existing site behavior, unrelated to this fix, flagging as minor observation only.

critical_code_review_comments: FeatureIndex component and FEATURE_GROUPS data in Iris.jsx are clean — no leftover undefined variable references (CAPABILITIES/COMMS/Check) found; the fix is complete and correct.
Accordion uses single openKey state (only one group open at a time) as intended per requirement; verified toggle-close and toggle-switch between groups both work correctly.

Note: 'communication' group has 6 items, 'intake' and 'security' groups have only 4 items each (not verified against original PDF spec, but matches data present in file) — not a bug, just noting for reference against requirement text which didn't specify counts for intake/security.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth involved in this test
context_for_next_testing_agent: This fix (FeatureIndex accordion on /xoiris-scheduling) is verified working end-to-end: no runtime errors, correct default-open state, correct accordion toggle (open/collapse/switch), no checkboxes, no rounded corners, and no regressions elsewhere on the page. One caveat found during testing: Playwright's standard mouse-driven .click(force=True) on the accordion header intermittently failed to register a proper toggle click because the mouse's travel path crossed over the top nav bar and triggered a hover mega-menu, which is a Playwright testing artifact, not an app bug — confirmed via element.evaluate('el => el.click()') that actual toggle logic works perfectly. No further action needed on this specific fix.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bugs found in this pass. Original bug (undefined CAPABILITIES/COMMS/Check causing ReferenceError) was already fixed prior to this test pass and confirmed resolved (zero console/page errors on load).
